# `alloc::lru` — declaration reference

Generated source inventory. Linked guides own runtime and semantic contracts; a listed declaration does not establish executable behavior.

[All modules](../README.md) · [Source](../../../stdlib/alloc/lru.lani#L8)

Layer: `alloc`. Role: module. Profile: **Source inventory**.

Fixed-capacity LRU cache: one node arena on intrusive hash-bucket chains (load at most one) and a doubly linked recency list. Only with_capacity allocates; put/get/peek/touch/remove/pop_oldest are O(1) expected and never allocate. Recency changes only through put, get and touch; a full put evicts the oldest entry.
